data.description:
testing_mode: GREEN

Run plugins/dso/scripts/build-review-agents.sh to rebuild all 10 reviewer agent files (code-reviewer-deep-arch.md, code-reviewer-deep-correctness.md, code-reviewer-deep-hygiene.md, code-reviewer-deep-verification.md, code-reviewer-light.md, code-reviewer-performance.md, code-reviewer-security-blue-team.md, code-reviewer-security-red-team.md, code-reviewer-standard.md, code-reviewer-test-quality.md). After rebuild, each file must contain the '## Severity Calibration Rubric' section inherited from reviewer-base.md.

## Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-*.md (10 files, REBUILD)

## Acceptance Criteria
- REPO_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)
- bash "$REPO_ROOT/plugins/dso/scripts/build-review-agents.sh" exits 0
- find "$REPO_ROOT/plugins/dso/agents" -name 'code-reviewer-*.md' | wc -l | tr -d ' ' outputs 10
- All 10 contain rubric: for f in "$REPO_ROOT/plugins/dso/agents"/code-reviewer-*.md; do grep -q '^## Severity Calibration Rubric' "$f" || { echo "MISSING: $f"; exit 1; }; done
- Existing fixture test still passes: bash "$REPO_ROOT/tests/unit/scripts/test-build-review-agents.sh" exits 0 (confirms test_build_produces_6_agent_files and all prior tests green)
- New test now passes: bash "$REPO_ROOT/tests/unit/scripts/test-build-review-agents.sh" 2>&1 | grep 'test_built_agents_contain_severity_calibration_rubric_heading' | grep -q 'PASS'
data.title: GREEN: Rebuild all 10 reviewer agent files via build-review-agents.sh
